results.title: Photosynthesis
results.textrank: Carbon dioxide and water become glucose and oxygen. This process sustains most life on Earth by producing oxygen and food.
results.lead2: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants convert sunlight into chemical energy. Chlorophyll in leaves absorbs light.

results.title: Newton Laws
results.textrank: The second law says force equals mass times acceleration. The third law says every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
results.lead2: Newton's first law states that an object stays at rest or in uniform motion unless acted upon by a force. The second law says force equals mass times acceleration.

results.title: Machine Learning
results.textrank: Machine learning algorithms learn patterns from data without being explicitly programmed for every rule. Deep learning uses multi-layer neural networks for vision and language tasks.
results.lead2: Machine learning algorithms learn patterns from data without being explicitly programmed for every rule. Supervised learning uses labeled examples.

results.title: French Revolution
results.textrank: The storming of the Bastille became a symbol of popular uprising. Ideals of liberty, equality, and fraternity influenced later democracies.
results.lead2: The French Revolution began in 1789 and reshaped European politics. The storming of the Bastille became a symbol of popular uprising.
